value.credibility_line: Guides conservatively and beats on revenue, but tax and R&D targets lag

promises.delivered: PAT grew from 8,513 cr in FY23 to 10,965 cr in FY25, CAGR ≈13.5% (FY23–FY25)
Q2 FY27 effective tax rate was 27.8%, above the ~25% target
Q2 FY27 revenue 161,000 million INR, up 11.8% YoY; FY27 not yet complete
Q1 FY27 R&D spend INR 8,264 million, 5.4% of sales; FY27 not yet complete
Q1 FY27 EBITDA margin 28.9% and Q2 FY27 29.3%, close to 29%; FY27 not yet complete

narrative_vs_numbers.claim: Management said EBITDA & earnings grew at a 13‑14% CAGR FY23‑FY25
narrative_vs_numbers.reality: PAT CAGR was ~13.5% from FY23 to FY25

narrative_vs_numbers.claim: Effective tax rate would be around 25% in FY27
narrative_vs_numbers.reality: Q2 FY27 tax rate was 27.8%, higher than 25%

narrative_vs_numbers.claim: Operating cost growth will moderate, delivering EBITDA margin near 29%
narrative_vs_numbers.reality: Q1 FY27 margin 28.9% and Q2 FY27 29.3%, near 29%

guidance_now: Expect FY27 revenue growth in the high single‑digit range
R&D spend to be lifted to 6‑7% of sales with a second‑half ramp‑up
Effective tax rate to stay around 27‑28% until Organon closes
Net cash balance to remain near USD 3.3 billion
Innovative medicines to drive specialty growth over the next 2‑3 years
bull: Guidance conservatively set; actual revenue growth outpaced high‑single‑digit target in Q2 FY27
EBITDA margins are on track, hitting the 29% range in Q2 FY27
PAT grew robustly FY23‑FY25, confirming strong earnings momentum
bear: Effective tax rate rose to 27.8%, above the ~25% guidance, eroding net profit
R&D spend in Q1 FY27 at 5.4% of sales falls short of the 6‑7% target
Debt‑financed M&A remains vague with no disclosed acquisitions, raising execution concerns
questions: Can you provide a detailed breakdown of FY27 R&D spend by segment to confirm the 6‑7% target?
What is the expected timeline and financing structure for the Organon acquisition, and any impact on leverage?
Given the effective tax rate now at 27.8%, what steps are being taken to mitigate further tax burden in FY27?
